subject: Re: MAP & exchange: ephemeral eval pack fingerprinting & return protocol
messages:
From: Lisa Brown <lisa@brightretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, procurement@brightretail.com
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff and dataset exchange – initial asks

Kimberly / Naomi,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, BrightRetail would like to move forward with a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to exchange an evaluation kit (prompt pack + ~1k test cases + small labeled sample) so our ML team can validate quality and throughput over Redwood Dedicated. High-level asks from our side: 

- Limited, ephemeral access to prompt pack and testcases (no reuse outside evaluation).
- Fingerprinting (file-level checksums) and a short provenance manifest for every asset.
- Clear acceptance gates: top-line QA metrics + a small manual review window (5 business days).
- Proof of destruction or return once the evaluation window closes.

We attached a brief list of questions (BR_MAP_questions.pdf) for scope. Our target close timeline is ~3 weeks (pilot start 2027-04-01, acceptance by 2027-04-15, takedown by 2027-04-22).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide single-use pre-signed URLs or short-lived tokens, and whether you support generation of file fingerprints and a signed manifest?

Best,
Lisa Brown
Head of ML Partnerships
BrightRetail

---
Attachment: BR_MAP_questions.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Lisa Brown <lisa@brightretail.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and dataset exchange – initial asks

Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Want to confirm Redwood can meet the constraints and propose a compact MAP that aligns with your timeline. Outline below is our proposed plan and deliverables; I attached an editable MAP spreadsheet (KR_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a small prompt pack sample for early verification.

Proposed MAP milestones:
1) 2027-03-22: Exchange of sample prompt pack + manifest (ephemeral access) — attachments: prompt-pack-sample.tar.gz (subset).
2) 2027-03-25: Pilot deployment on Redwood Dedicated (test runs + throughput check).
3) 2027-04-01: Full evaluation dataset provisioned (S3 link, single-use pre-signed URLs + one-time tokens).
4) 2027-04-08: Acceptance window begins (5 business days for BrightRetail QA).
5) 2027-04-15: Formal acceptance / sign-off or issue log.
6) 2027-04-22: Takedown & destruction confirmation / receipt of proof.

Security and usage constraints we will enforce by default:
- Assets hosted in a private S3 bucket with access via short-lived (≤24h) pre-signed URLs and one-time-use tokens tracked in our audit logs.
- Each file will carry an SHA256 fingerprint; we will publish a signed manifest (PKI-signed by Redwood) at time of delivery.
- Access is restricted to named BrightRetail accounts; derived copies are prohibited per MAP (we will include a one-paragraph usage covenant in the MAP that mirrors your ask).
- We will issue a takedown report that includes S3 object deletions, associated access logs (90 days), and a signed destruction statement.

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Top-line latency under target for your sample size (we'll include sample-run artifacts).
- Error/failure rate below agreed threshold (TBD in MAP spreadsheet).
- Manual review: 5 business days to escalate quality issues.

Attachments: KR_MAP_v1.xlsx, prompt-pack-sample.tar.gz (tarball, 12MB - sample subset).

If this looks reasonable I can circulate a cleaned MAP and we can add legal/PROC comments (Naomi — can you flag any procurement or DPA prerequisites we should expect on their side?).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: KR_MAP_v1.xlsx, prompt-pack-sample.tar.gz
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Lisa Brown <lisa@brightretail.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and dataset exchange – proposed access controls

Lisa / Kim — quick procurement/security notes from our side to speed closure: 

- We can do pre-signed URLs but will also apply a one-time nonce server-side so a URL cannot be replayed.
- Fingerprints: we will provide SHA256 + file size, and a signed manifest published to an internal object path (we will include a signature header for audit).
- Takedown proof: deletion receipts + a short CSV of access events during the exposure window. We retain logs for 90 days for incident response.
- DPA: our standard DPA terms are compatible; if you have a stricter data retention or destruction clause please share the snippet.

Two asks for BrightRetail to confirm: 
1) Are BrightRetail reviewers allowed to copy small samples for internal bug tracking (yes/no)? We typically require permission because copies increase risk.
2) Will you want us to watermark any prompt-pack artifacts (we can embed lightweight file-level markers)?

If both are no/yes, we will bake the language into the MAP spreadsheet and produce a final doc for signature.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@brightretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Lisa Brown <lisa@brightretail.com>, procurement@brightretail.com
Date: 2027-03-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and dataset exchange – procurement timeline & DPA

Kimberly / Naomi — thanks. Quick answers from BrightRetail: 

- Small internal copies: allowed for bug reports only, limited to named engineers; we will list allowed reviewers in the MAP.
- Watermarking: yes, please. A lightweight, non-intrusive fingerprint inside prompt pack artifacts is preferred.

Procurement notes: procurement internal timeline for signature is tight — we can run the MAP agreement alongside our DPA review but we need the MAP finalized by 2027-03-25 to meet internal approvals for a pilot start on 2027-04-01. Attached is our draft DPA for your legal team (BR_DPA_draft.pdf).

Also: we'll need the following evidence at takedown: deletion receipts, the SHA256 manifest, and a short signed attestation from Redwood operations that all pre-signed URLs are revoked.

If you can hit those items in the MAP and confirm a final doc by 03/25, we will circulate to procurement and legal.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Sr. Manager, Data Science Partnerships
BrightRetail

---
Attachment: BR_DPA_draft.pdf (PDF, 18 pages)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Markus Klein <markus@brightretail.com>, Lisa Brown <lisa@brightretail.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP + milestones confirmed (BR-4497-MAP)

Markus / Lisa — thanks for the quick replies and the DPA. We've updated the MAP spreadsheet (final tab) to reflect: 

- Explicit list of named reviewers (limited copy permission for bug reporting).
- Embedded lightweight watermarking option turned on for prompt-pack artifacts.
- Delivery mechanics: S3 provisioned path + one-time-use pre-signed URLs (≤24h) + server-side nonce binding.
- Fingerprint manifest: SHA256 + size; signed manifest posted to s3://redwood-secure/brightretail/BR-4497-manifest.json and attached to the DocuSign envelope.
- Acceptance gates and dates: pilot start 2027-04-01; acceptance window 2027-04-08—04-15; takedown 2027-04-22.
- Takedown evidence package: deletion receipts, manifest, access-CSV, and signed attestation from Redwood Ops.

Next steps:
- I will upload the final MAP and the sample prompt-pack to the secure bucket tonight. Link (internal): s3://redwood-secure/brightretail/ephemeral/prompt-pack-sample.tar.gz
- Naomi will route the DocuSign envelope (BR-4497-MAP) that bundles the MAP and the short usage covenant for signature.
- Once signed, we will provision pre-signed URLs for your named reviewers and push the SHA256 manifest.

Thanks — we'll aim to have everything live before 2027-03-25 so procurement can greenlight the pilot.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: (manifest will be posted at delivery), prompt-pack-sample.tar.gz (uploaded to secure bucket), DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/BR-4497-MAP
